question: Should generic transient tool progress become a new public ReplyPayload contract, or should this fix use the existing isStatusNotice-based contract?
rationale: Both contracts describe transient non-answer content, and selecting their permanent semantic boundary affects third-party plugins and sibling channels beyond what code inspection can safely decide.

options.title: Reuse isStatusNotice
options.body: Represent transient tool summaries with the existing status-notice semantic and keep Slack reaction details channel-local.

options.title: Approve tool-progress kind
options.body: Retain the new public kind only after defining why isStatusNotice is insufficient and documenting sibling-channel and plugin expectations.

recommendation.title: Reuse isStatusNotice
recommendation.body: Represent transient tool summaries with the existing status-notice semantic and keep Slack reaction details channel-local.

likelyOwner.reason: The overlapping status and fast-mode progress semantics on current main both trace to his recent contract commit.
